title: CheckRequest
description: Which throwaway copy of the code to check, which checks to run there, and how long each may take. The checks may write inside the copy and nowhere else.

folder.description: A throwaway copy of the code that the caller made for this call and will remove afterwards; never a worktree a builder works in. It is inside the project, and given relative to it or in full. The toolchain's tools may write inside it, such as a build output or a cache, and write nothing outside it. A verdict is about the code as the caller gave it, so a second call on the same folder gives the same verdicts.

items.description: The name of one check, as describe lists it.

checks.description: The checks to run; left out, every check runs. A name the toolchain does not have is refused.

timeLimitSeconds.description: How long one check may run before it is stopped and its verdict is inconclusive; left out, the toolchain's own limit applies. A whole suite may need up to 1000 seconds: the kit's own takes about 450 alone and longer beside another run.
